title: My Footprints Stop at the River
summary: An eleven-year-old finds tomorrow’s footprints leading to the river. That night, much larger bare prints return to the door and his own footprints change.
frame_0: The child stands in his cottage doorway above the blue trail. His boot prints wind alone down the hill and stop at the river.
package_differences: Uses Jake’s updated Flashloop logo, handle and five-second spoken phone ending. Both result tiles show the same child and cottage after the final line.
